newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil IGP-DI inflation rises 9.34 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Brazil IGP-DI inflation rises 9.34 pct in 1996.

text.p: Brazil's Indice Geral de Precos - Disponibilidade Interna (IGP-DI) rose 9.34 percent in 1996, against a 14.78 percent advance in 1995, the independent research institute Getulio Vargas Foundation (FGV) said.
In December 1996, the IGP-DI inflation index rose 0.88 percent against 0.28 percent in November last year, FGV said.

The IGP-DI index is a compilation of three indices - the IPA wholesale price index, which rose 8.09 percent in 1996, the IPC consumer price index, which advanced 11.34 percent in the year, and the INCC national index of construction costs, which gained 9.56 percent.
In December, the IPA rose 1.21 percent, the IPC advanced 0.44 percent, and the INCC gained 0.59 percent.
The FGV releases the IGP-DI figure once a month.
